resources.string:
Save your endpoints, API tokens, speech and cleanup settings, languages, lane tokens, triggers and cues in a password-protected file. Choose where to keep it.

Audio, transcripts, caption consent and Android permissions are excluded. After a reinstall, enable accessibility and microphone access again, and opt into captions separately.

Restoring replaces saved configuration. Keep the backup and its passphrase safe: anyone with both can use your API tokens. There is no passphrase recovery.
Use a long, unique passphrase. You will need it to restore this file on a new installation.
Enter this backup’s passphrase. Restoring replaces your endpoints, API tokens and configuration. Finish any dictation or caption first.
Use 12–1024 characters; both entries must match.
Choose where to save the encrypted backup.
Finish or cancel the current dictation or caption, then restore again.
Restore could not be completed. Retry from your backup before dictating.
Could not read or write this backup. Check the passphrase, file and destination, then try again. An unreadable backup does not change settings.
